problem.text: In $\triangle ABC$ shown in the figure, $AB = 7$, $BC = 8$, $CA = 9$, and $\overline{AH}$ is an altitude. Points $D$ and $E$ lie on sides $\overline{AC}$ and $\overline{AB}$, respectively, so that $\overline{BD}$ and $\overline{CE}$ are angle bisectors, intersecting $\overline{AH}$ at $Q$ and $P$, respectively. What is $PQ$?

steps.title: Where to start: both points are on the altitude
steps.body: $P$ and $Q$ both lie on $AH$, so $PQ$ is the difference of $AQ$ and $AP$. Each point is where an angle bisector crosses $AH$: in triangle $ABH$, $BQ$ bisects the angle at $B$, and in triangle $ACH$, $CP$ bisects the angle at $C$. The angle bisector theorem will locate them, but first we need $BH$, $CH$ and $AH$. Let $CH = x$ and $AH = h$.

your_turn.prompt: Write two Pythagorean equations, one for right triangle $ACH$ and one for right triangle $ABH$.

steps.title: Solve for the pieces of $BC$ and the altitude
steps.body:
Subtract the second equation from the first. The $h^2$ cancels and so does $x^2$:
$$x^2 - (8-x)^2 = 81 - 49 \;\Rightarrow\; 16x - 64 = 32 \;\Rightarrow\; x = 6.$$
So $CH = 6$ and $HB = 2$.

steps.title: Locate $Q$ with the angle bisector theorem
steps.body: In triangle $ABH$, $BQ$ bisects $\angle ABH$ (the same angle as $\angle ABC$, since $H$ is on $BC$). So it splits $AH$ in the ratio of the sides next to $B$: $\frac{AQ}{QH} = \frac{AB}{BH} = \frac72$.

steps.title: Locate $P$ the same way
steps.body: In triangle $ACH$, $CP$ bisects $\angle ACH$, so $\frac{AP}{PH} = \frac{AC}{CH} = \frac96 = \frac32$. That makes $AP$ equal to $\frac35$ of $AH$.

your_turn.prompt: Which point is closer to $A$, $P$ or $Q$? Compare the fractions of $AH$.
your_turn.answer: $P$, because $\frac35 = \frac{27}{45}$ is less than $\frac79 = \frac{35}{45}$. This matches the figure.

steps.title: Put it together
steps.body:
$AP = \frac35\cdot 3\sqrt5 = \frac{9\sqrt5}{5}$, and since $P$ is between $A$ and $Q$,
$$PQ = AQ - AP = \frac{7\sqrt5}{3} - \frac{9\sqrt5}{5} = \frac{35\sqrt5 - 27\sqrt5}{15} = \frac{8}{15}\sqrt5.$$
The answer is **(D)**.
